items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I'm very proud of him, Jake Wiley from Detroit. He was playing a technique on the trombone that is still in vogue to this day.

ctx.x: In that he helped so many great musicians, black and white.
Yeah. Well, Jake Wiley was one of the people Bobby's father helped. And we mentioned JC on the drums and Al Casey was on the guitar, and Al Hall on bass.
